findings.headline: Migrate this A import from @solidjs/router, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's router (@solidjs/router 2.0.0-next.44) replaces this with a plain <a href> with replace, noscroll, and state attributes; active styling through [data-active] or [aria-current="page"].
findings.guidance: Replace <A> with <a>, move activeClass, inactiveClass, and end to CSS attribute selectors, and check relative hrefs, which now resolve with browser URL semantics.

findings.headline: Migrate this Route import from @solidjs/router, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's router (@solidjs/router 2.0.0-next.44) replaces this with route config objects { path, component, preload, matchFilters, info, children }.
findings.guidance: Convert each <Route> to a config object passed to createRouter({ routes }); nesting becomes children arrays, and defineRoutes keeps paths typed.

findings.headline: Migrate this Router import from @solidjs/router, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's router (@solidjs/router 2.0.0-next.44) replaces this with a createRouter({ routes }) instance rendered as <Router>{(props) => ...}</Router>.
findings.guidance: Create the router outside JSX from route config objects; the root prop becomes the render-prop child and rootPreload becomes the config preload option.

findings.headline: Replace this deprecated action import from @solidjs/router.
findings.why: Solid 2's router (@solidjs/router 2.0.0-next.44) replaces this with formAction (type FormAction).
findings.guidance: action remains a deprecated alias with a dev warning; rename it, and replace the removed onComplete option with .onSettled(hook).

findings.headline: Migrate this cache import from @solidjs/router, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's router (@solidjs/router 2.0.0-next.44) replaces this with query.
findings.guidance: cache was a deprecated alias of query in 1.x and is gone in 2.x; import query instead.

findings.headline: Migrate this createAsync import from @solidjs/router, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's router (@solidjs/router 2.0.0-next.44) replaces this with createMemo(() => queryFn(args)) from solid-js inside a Loading boundary.
findings.guidance: Read query results with an async createMemo; initialValue, deferStream, and .latest need manual mapping.

findings.headline: Review this revalidate import from @solidjs/router, whose Solid 2 behavior changed.
findings.why: Solid 2's router (@solidjs/router 2.0.0-next.44) replaces this with revalidate, which now returns void.
findings.guidance: Awaiting revalidate() no longer waits for the refetch to finish.

findings.headline: Migrate this MetaProvider import from @solidjs/meta, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's head management (useHead in @solidjs/web; @solidjs/meta 1.0.0-next.2) replaces this with nothing: delete the provider.
findings.guidance: The head registry is ambient in Solid 2, so remove MetaProvider and any server tags plumbing.

findings.headline: Migrate this useHead import from @solidjs/meta, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's head management (useHead in @solidjs/web; @solidjs/meta 1.0.0-next.2) replaces this with useHead from @solidjs/web, taking { tag, props, key? }, an array, or a function.
findings.guidance: Move the import to @solidjs/web; the descriptor shape changed, and id, setting, and ref are gone.

findings.headline: Migrate this clientOnly import from @solidjs/start, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's application layer (@solidjs/vite-plugin start mode and core @solidjs/web) replaces this with clientOnly from @solidjs/web.
findings.guidance: Default-export loaders move directly; a loader resolving to a named component needs clientOnly(() => import(m), { export: "Name" }).

findings.headline: Migrate this FileRoutes import from @solidjs/start/router, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's application layer (@solidjs/vite-plugin start mode and core @solidjs/web) replaces this with fileRoutes(pageRoutes) from @solidjs/router/fs with pageRoutes from virtual:file-routes, passed to createRouter({ routes }).
findings.guidance: Also add the fileRoutes() Vite plugin from filesystem-routing/vite, a different function with the same name.

findings.headline: Migrate this @solidjs/start/server import, which has no Solid 2 release.
findings.why: Neither @solidjs/start nor vinxi has a release that targets Solid 2; @solidjs/vite-plugin start mode and the core @solidjs/web runtime provide the application layer instead, and the names this import takes (someOtherHelper) have no audited one-to-one replacement.
findings.guidance: Find the Solid 2 equivalent of what this import provides in the @solidjs/vite-plugin start mode documentation or in @solidjs/web, and remove the import.

findings.headline: Migrate this getCookie import from vinxi/http, which Solid 2 removes or moves.
findings.why: Solid 2's application layer (@solidjs/vite-plugin start mode and core @solidjs/web) replaces this with parseCookieHeader(getRequestEvent().request.headers.get("cookie")) from @solidjs/web.
findings.guidance: Cookie access is a codec over native Headers; writes use serializeCookie appended to the response headers.

findings.headline: Migrate this vinxi/http import, which has no Solid 2 release.
findings.why: Neither @solidjs/start nor vinxi has a release that targets Solid 2; @solidjs/vite-plugin start mode and the core @solidjs/web runtime provide the application layer instead, and the names this import takes (setCookie) have no audited one-to-one replacement.
findings.guidance: Find the Solid 2 equivalent of what this import provides in the @solidjs/vite-plugin start mode documentation or in @solidjs/web, and remove the import.
